summary: The Food and Drug Administration published its fiscal 2027 guidance priorities Thursday, setting itself the goal of finalizing and drafting artificial intelligence documents. Over the coming 12 months, the FDA’s top priorities include finalizing guidance on marketing submissions and lifecycle management for AI-enabled devices and drafting generative AI advice. The agency is also prioritizing the swift finalization of its guidance on premarket submissions of robotically assisted surgical devices, which it published in draft form last week.
